description: Plugin hooks for project-toolkit. Every registration routes through invoke_dispatch_claude.py (one process per (event, matcher) group, issue #3075); membership lives in dispatch_groups.json (plugin-* groups). Inside a checkout of the repo that publishes this plugin, the dispatcher exits immediately so hooks do not double-fire with .claude/settings.json.

hooks.command: _ptr="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; _warn="project-toolkit@ai-agents WARNING: hooks DISABLED (your session is unaffected)."; if [ -z "$_ptr" ]; then echo "$_warn Plugin root unresolvable (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT empty). Reinstall: /install-plugin rjmurillo/ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$_ptr" ]; then echo "$_warn Plugin root is not a directory: $_ptr. Reinstall: /install-plugin rjmurillo/ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; _i=python3; if ! command -v "$_i" >/dev/null 2>&1; then _i=python; fi; if ! command -v "$_i" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$_warn No interpreter found. Install Python >= 3.10: https://www.python.org/downloads/" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -r "$_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" ]; then echo "$_warn Dispatcher missing: $_ptr/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py. Reinstall: /install-plugin rjmurillo/ai-agents" >&2; exit 0; fi; python3 -u "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/invoke_dispatch_claude.py" --group plugin-posttooluse-1-markdown_auto_lint
